description: Purr-fect cat names — mischievous troublemakers, regal royals, or delicious food-inspired names for your feline.

faqs.a: Mischievous (like Bandit), regal (like Duchess), and food names (like Mochi) — each with its own bank.
Yes — every name is generated fresh from themed banks and results are deduplicated automatically.
Click any name or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
faqs.q: How do I copy a name?

howto: Pick mischievous, regal, or food style.
Choose how many names to generate.
Press Generate, then click any name to copy it.
title: Cat Name Generator
